description: An ordered collection of blocks and other channels, as on Are.na. A channel is a folder in the vault; its _channel.md file holds these properties, and its body is the channel's description. A folder with no _channel.md is still a channel, with no ID yet. A block is in its folder's channel and in every channel its channels property names.

title.description: The channel's name. Without one, its folder's name.

kind.description: collection is the default. A concept channel is an idea you collect toward. An import channel holds what one connector brought in.

order.description: The order of the channel's items, each a block's slug or a channel's path. Items not listed follow, newest first.

site.description: Set when the channel is a section of the author's public site.
